exposure: infant gestational age at birth (preterm, term)
outcome: protein, lipid, carbohydrate, and energy content of breast milk
cohort: 39 mothers who had delivered preterm infants and 21 mothers of term infants
finding: Colostral milk protein concentrations were significantly higher and decreased over the first 4 weeks of lactation in both preterm and term infant groups, while fat, carbohydrate, and energy content were lowest in the colostrum and increased over time.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was found to have statistically significant correlation with protein content of the milk.
